reviewProvenance.manualVisualComparison: Source gallery view 5 and canonical published cover depict precisely the same Aquaman mounted on green sea-horse creature, holding golden trident, with curling blue-purple wave/ruins on the same sculpted base. Other textual Aquaman candidates depict distinct sculptures (standing, shark, throne, classical pose).
reviewProvenance.identityProofInterpretation: Explicit visual matching of sculpture, pose, base and staging, corroborated by verified source SHA-256 and canonical dHash. Other source name matches were not auto-approved.

mediaReview.notes: ZZ studio watermark and creator graphics appear on the source and public cover; rights for additional media are unverified. Do not import/crop/alter promotional marks, add gallery or replace current cover based on identity approval.

decision.nextGate: Keep one canonical model and review source media rights/branding separately before publication.
